Reading the answer, the macro that disables the renaming is `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`. The answer says these files define it:

- `library/common.h` (line 132)
- `programs/ssl/ssl_server2.c` (line 8)
- `programs/ssl/ssl_client2.c` (line 8)

It names the test suites and `ssl_context_info.c` only as files that do not turn it on.

ITEMS:
library/common.h
programs/ssl/ssl_server2.c
programs/ssl/ssl_client2.c
END
